info.title: Kosta API
info.description:
Kosta is a double-entry ledger and payments API for wallet-based fintech products.

**Core guarantees**

- **Double-entry accounting.** Every movement of money is a journal entry whose postings sum to zero. A deferred Postgres trigger rejects any unbalanced entry at commit time.
- **No overdrafts.** Accounts are row-locked in a fixed order during each entry, and a database CHECK constraint stops customer balances going below zero even if application code is wrong.
- **Exactly-once money movement.** Transfers and withdrawals require an `Idempotency-Key`. Retries replay the original response.
- **Append-only ledger.** Postings and journal entries cannot be updated or deleted; corrections are new entries.
- **Integer money.** All amounts are integers in minor units (kobo, cents). No floating point anywhere.
- **Signed, replay-safe webhooks** for deposits, de-duplicated by event id and provider reference.
- **Full audit trail** written in the same transaction as each change, plus an on-demand reconciliation report.

**Authentication**

Send `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. Client keys see only the wallets they created. Admin keys can review payouts, freeze accounts, read the audit log and run reconciliation.

**Errors**

Every error has the shape `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {} } }`. Branch on `code`.

post.description: Atomically debits the source wallet and credits the destination wallet in one balanced journal entry. The source must belong to the caller; the destination can be any customer wallet in the same currency. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: retries return the original result and never move money twice.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Unique key per logical operation (a UUID works). Retrying with the same key and body returns the original response instead of moving money twice.

post.summary: Request a payout to a bank account
post.description: Places a hold on amount + fee by moving it from the wallet into the withdrawals_pending system account, so the funds cannot be spent twice while the payout is reviewed. An admin then approves (funds leave the platform) or rejects (hold is released back to the wallet). Requires an Idempotency-Key header.

post.summary: Receive a deposit notification from a payment provider
post.description:
Credits a wallet when the provider confirms a payment. Security and safety:

- HMAC-SHA256 signature in `X-Kosta-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` computed over `<t>.<raw body>`
- Requests older than 5 minutes are rejected (replay protection)
- Each event id and each provider reference can only ever credit once, so provider retries are harmless
- Always answers 200 for well-formed signed events so the provider stops retrying; failures are recorded for ops review

get.description: Proves the books are correct. Checks that (1) postings in every currency sum to exactly zero, (2) every cached account balance equals the sum of its postings, and (3) no journal entry is unbalanced. Also returns system account positions: settlement (money that should be at the bank), funds held for pending payouts, and fee revenue. Safe to run on a schedule and alert on ok = false.
